qa_pairs.question: What kind of information is presented in the graph titled "CPU Core Memory" within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "CPU Core Memory" graph in the Metrix portal displays a graphical representation of the average CPU core and memory usage over recent days.

qa_pairs.question: Which section of the Metrix portal offers a graph showing the average CPU core and memory usage over the last few days?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can find a graphical representation of their average CPU core and memory usage over the last few days within the 'Statistiques des tâches' (Task Statistics) section of the Metrix portal.
